arm_action: normalized joint-reference velocity; integrated by the environment
gripper_action: absolute nominal jaw width, normalized to [-1, 1]
image_preprocessing: model-specific resize/crop/normalize at training and inference; preserve native master frames
training_targets: contiguous valid expert actions; mask episode ends and stop chunks before injected faults
normalization: action targets already use the environment's [-1, 1] control units; proprio statistics from training split only
pretrained_action_compatibility: no implicit Cartesian, joint-position, or motor-space conversion
